chapter_meta_description: Han Li witnesses the Crimsonflame Elder’s sudden betrayal, linking events to Demonic Cores and the ancient teleportation array. A frantic escape begins.
og_title: Chapter 414 – The Tide Turns Overseas – Betrayal | A Record of a Mortal’s Journey
og_description: A double-cross shatters the rebel camp. Han Li flees while his mind races connecting ghost tokens, Demonic Cores, and a forgotten skeleton.
twitter_title: Ch 414: Betrayal at sea – Crimsonflame Elder turns on his ally
twitter_description: Four Demonic Core projections buy time with their lives. Han Li runs, analyzing the clues that tie this mess to the ghost-head token.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare pearl forged from abyssal crystal, possessing extreme yin and cold properties; used to counter Heavenly Corpse Fire.
A dark-aligned alternative to the orthodox Golden Core, cultivated through forbidden arts that often sacrifice lifespan or humanity.
A powerful demonic flame technique associated with Extreme Yin Ancestor, capable of destroying ghost-head treasures.
A forbidden cultivation art derived from the Yue Emperor’s *Profound Yin Scripture*, using extreme yin energy; practiced by Wuchou.
A technique that splits a cultivator’s consciousness into multiple bodies, each carrying a portion of their Demonic Core; often used for suicidal last stands.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Crimsonflame Elder betray the middle-aged man?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he had secretly allied with Extreme Yin Ancestor – in the cultivation world, loyalty is a commodity that always flows to the stronger party. The “master-apprentice bond” was never real.

They are multiple bodies created by a cultivator who has condensed a Demonic Core – a dark version of a Golden Core. Each projection carries a fragment of the core’s power, and can be sacrificed without ending the main body.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li think about the ancient teleportation array?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The *Profound Yin Scripture* (which contained Demonic Core cultivation methods) was found near an ancient teleportation array in Tiannan. Wuchou’s art in the Chaotic Star Sea uses the same foundation – suggesting the array was used by that same reclusive sect to spread their arts across realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why were the four Hidden Kill Sect cultivators so suicidal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They were Demonic Core projections, engineered to fight without self-preservation. Their master (the middle-aged man) ordered them to stall Extreme Yin Ancestor so he could escape – but even that failed.
